meta.quantum_definition: Quantum = amount paid; else net assessed loss; else gross loss. Estimates are excluded (they hold placeholders and one INR 93 cr outlier).

framework.name: Conditions / Causes / Clauses
framework.gap: Cause is on every claim. Extent and cover type exist for one account only. Clause (ICC A/B/C, exclusions, warranties) is not on any claim row.

framework.name: Consignor / Assured
framework.gap: Consignor is named on most claims. The assured is the account itself, so it adds no spread.

framework.name: Consignee
framework.gap: Named on 99% of claims. Many are dealers and branches of the same assured.

framework.name: Commerce (type of trade)
framework.gap: Domestic / import / export only, and 99.6% domestic. No incoterm, sale type or letter-of-credit field.

framework.name: Commodity
framework.gap: Derived from goods text and the account's trade. No HSN code and no description standard in any file.

framework.name: Carriage (mode)
framework.gap: Mode is reported by four accounts. For the rest Road is assumed and labelled 'assumed'. No vessel, flight or vehicle class.

framework.name: Carrier
framework.gap: Named on 98% of claims, normalised by alias rules.

framework.name: Cities (stuffing, POL, POD, delivery)
framework.gap: Origin, destination and loss city only. Port of loading, port of discharge, stuffing point and transhipment are not captured.

framework.name: Climate
framework.gap: No weather data in any file. Season and month are read from the loss date. Rainfall, flood, cyclone and temperature by city and month would need an external feed.

framework.name: Current affairs / Corruption
framework.gap: No event, strike, disruption or corruption-index data. Integrity-type losses are a proxy, and quarters with abnormal volume are flagged for you to match to events.

framework.name: Claims (the claim itself and its handling)
framework.gap: Count and quantum on every claim. Dates for delay and settlement exist for most accounts.

framework.name: Costs
framework.gap: Gross, salvage, excess and paid exist for some accounts, expense (LAE) for a few. No premium, freight or turnover, so no loss ratio.

names: Claims (the claim itself and its handling)

costs.gap: No premium, freight or turnover in any file: loss ratio and cost-of-claims-per-rupee-insured cannot be computed.

climate.gap: Season and month are read from the loss date. Rainfall, flood, cyclone and temperature by city and month are not in the files.

current_affairs.event_method: Per account, quarters whose claim count is 3+ robust standard deviations from that account's own median (accounts with 8+ quarters of 20+ claims).
current_affairs.gap: No event, strike, disruption or corruption-index data. Integrity-type loss is a proxy; event quarters are statistical outliers for you to match to real events.

c_framework.method: Cramer's V with small-sample bias correction, computed inside each account (accounts with 500+ claims having both fields) and averaged by claims, so a field supplied by one account does not correlate with everything that account trades. Pairs from the same C, pairs where one field is derived from the other, and the assured (which is the account itself) are excluded. The C-level cell is the strongest dimension pair. 'Explains claim size' is the same measure against the claim-size band.

large_ticket_index.label: Share of INR 1L+ claims vs norm

surveyors.method: bleed_index = surveyor quantum / what the same claims would cost at the account-and-commodity average ticket (zero-sum across surveyors); flagged when >1.25 and excess >= INR 2 lakh, min 15 valued claims

recovery.method: Modelled: quantum x recovery % by cause pattern from config/assumption_rules.json (default profile). The source files record INR 0 of actual recoveries.

data_quality.hsn_note: No HSN code exists in any source file. 'hsn_chapter_indicative' is keyword-derived from goods descriptions and must not be used for tax or customs purposes.
data_quality.carrier_note: Carrier = transporter name normalised by alias rules; 'Own transport (client)' is excluded from recovery targets.

actions.action: Review Surveyor 4: quantum is 1.67x the account-and-commodity average, INR 23,574,018 above expectation across 371 claims.
Salvage: 'Commodity 1' recovers 32.69% vs 49.06% benchmark; gap worth INR 197,895,739.
Carrier 2 appears in 2 accounts with INR 48,997,237 of claims; open a single recovery negotiation (modelled potential INR 2,079,994).
Record actual recoveries: files show INR 0 recovered against INR 48,783,740 modelled potential.
Capture HSN codes, carrier and surveyor at FNOL: carrier is unspecified on 2.2% and surveyor on 83% of claims.
